ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Which organism consumes sea-whip as a food source?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, there is a "sea-whip" label on the left side, and in the diagram there is an arrow from sea-whip slanting upward pointing to the "reef sharks" label above. Reasoning: A food web usually uses arrows to indicate energy or food from the organism being eaten pointing to the consumer; therefore, from sea-whip pointing to reef sharks indicates that reef sharks consume sea-whip.
